snippets.snippet: MCEO – formRWP – April 1, 2026 Page 2 of 2 GENERAL PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO PERMITS You, as applicant and if this permit is approved, as permit holder, must notify the Miami County Engineer’s Office not less than 2 working days prior to commencement of the work covered under this permit. A copy of the issued permit must be onsite and available upon request. All work to be completed shall be under the supervision and to the satisfaction of the County Engineer or his designated representative (hereinafter referred to as “the Engineer”). Any work found to be unacceptable to the Engineer shall be removed, or corrected, by you, the permit holder, at your sole expense.
